messages:
nala (eng-platform): thinking about a new econ surface in the console — per-model card showing avg token unit cost, cache savings credited, hit rate, and sticky-routing impact. rough mock: https://internal.redwood/mock/econ-surface.png

jordan (product): this is great. main user story: "why did my cost spike this week" — need time-series + rollout split (canary vs prod).

micah (eng-ml): computing per-model cost is straightforward: tokens * model_sku_price then subtract cache credits. the tricky bit is cache attribution for shared prefixes. proposal: TTL-based prefix ownership -> credits go to creator route while TTL valid.

ravi (backend): TTL ownership works but increases state. alternative: sample lineage for a fraction of requests and use statistical attribution to apportion credits. cheaper at scale.

keera (design): UI note: top-level should show a single "effective $/1k tokens" with a chevron to expand to breakdown by route, model, and cache credits. highlight deltas vs baseline and annotate rollouts.

sasha (eng-sre): cardinality concern — per-tenant+per-route+per-model at 1m resolution will explode. we need sketches/hll + sampling. real-time should be approximate.

nala (eng-platform): suggested approach: 1) streaming aggregates (per-model, per-route) at 1m using sketches, 2) full lineage sampling for top-N outliers, 3) nightly offline reconciliation for final credits.

jordan (product): nightly reconciliation OK for billing. but console users expect near realtime debugging. can we show an approximate realtime value and mark it as "estimate" until reconciliation?

ravi (backend): yes — implement a `cache_credit_estimate` field in internal API responses that includes an estimate and confidence score. reconciliation endpoint will return final numbers.

micah (eng-ml): internal API debate: should we surface `unit_cost` or `cache_credit` on each generation response? customers want instrumentation, but that may leak internal pricing or add noise to logs.

keera (design): exposing on the generation response may clutter SDK output. alternative: return cost info via headers (e.g., `X-Redwood-Unit-Cost`) behind an opt-in flag.

sasha (eng-sre): headers can be easier but can also be logged or forged by proxies. consider signing the header or requiring retrieval from a metadata endpoint for integrity.

nala (eng-platform): also need to clarify quotas/charging interplay — if sticky routing returns cached tokens, UI should show both "tokens billed" and "effective tokens consumed" so customers see where savings came from.

ravi (backend): nightly aggregation pseudo-SQL for RFC: 
```
INSERT INTO model_econ_daily
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) as day, model, route, sum(tokens) as tokens,
       sum(tokens * model_price) as gross_cost,
       sum(cache_saved_tokens * model_price) as cache_savings
FROM token_events
GROUP BY day, model, route;
```

jordan (product): UX ask: allow compare windows (pre/post rollout) to show cost delta and attribution to changes in model, quantization, or routing policy.

keera (design): add a "confidence" pill next to realtime numbers: e.g., Realtime (est, 78% confidence) vs Reconciled (final). avoids confusion.

micah (eng-ml): edge case: multi-tenant cache reuse — for privacy we shouldn't attribute cross-tenant savings. we should only credit the tenant that created the prefix; otherwise keep a global metric for cluster-level cache efficiency.

ravi (backend): agreed. if tenant A creates a prefix used by B (common in public datasets), credit A only; B gets no direct savings but we surface a global efficiency metric.

sasha (eng-sre): alert rules: detect sudden drop in cache hit rate + simultaneous cost spike. propose signal: if hit_rate < 0.1 and cost_rate increases > 3x baseline in 15m, fire P1 slack.

nala (eng-platform): rollout plan idea: alpha to internal teams, beta to 10% of org accounts with opt-in flag, then GA after 2-week reconciliation window and stability criteria.

deploy-bot: deploy started to eng-platform-canary @ 2198765500

ravi (backend): implement a per-org feature flag `econ_console.v1_enabled` default false. also add telemetry hook for "econ_panel.viewed" to gauge adoption.

jordan (product): agreed. add metric for "cost_insight_helped" when user resolves an incident after using the panel.

keera (design): small language nit: avoid raw "tokens" at top level for non-devs. show "$ per 1k tokens" and "cache saved $" with expandable token counts for power users.

micah (eng-ml): sampling plan suggestion: 1% full lineage logs (for offline attribution modeling), 10% detailed token counters, rest aggregated sketches. keeps storage sane.

nala (eng-platform): ok i'm going to draft an RFC with: schema for `model_econ_daily`, API change for `cache_credit_estimate`, realtime vs reconciled UX states, sampling plan, and a rollout checklist. ping me for review.

jordan (product): :thumbsup:

sasha (eng-sre): :eyes:

keera (design): love it.

cost-bot: note recorded: econ-surface RFC created (#CF-1123)

nala (eng-platform): created RFC: https://rfc.internal/redwood/CF-1123

nala (eng-platform): bump — can folks review before EOD Friday?

ravi (backend): I'll review today.

micah (eng-ml): me too.

jordan (product): can we get the initial figma mock by tomorrow? thanks.

keera (design): done: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/econ-surface
